1479-1671-8337.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, M'Ress, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and M'Ress trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

240-1879-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

1170-5131-6595-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6595-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Displacer Kitten and Lyse Hext's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

1981-2415-6097-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6097-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

851-3129-6441-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

5147-6461--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7379.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Zack Fair.
When Zack Fair dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

280-872-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
280-872-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1170-1329-1492-4460.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-4460.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

331-3693-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Furnace of Rath.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1329-1778-2178-6797.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-6797.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3499-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
3499-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2457-4289-4927.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

411-4103-4613-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-4103-4613-6602.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

3817-5147-5170.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
3817-5147-5170.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield, and causing you to gain 5 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 2.
Repeat.

1329-1778-2178-3698.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-3698.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

488-641-874-2478-4986.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of either Delif's Cone or Mishra's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-874-2478-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1789-2921-4452-5649.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-2921-4452-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-2464-3129-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2464-3129-6218.notablePrerequisites:
Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2464-3129-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1477-2558-5687-5689.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Raiders' Spoils, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

245-1069-1879-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-1879-5499.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

1987-4377-4423-4863.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4377-4423-4863.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

2167-3703-5626-5721.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-3703-5626-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Sporemound triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

719-2511-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
719-2511-5853.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
719-2511-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

427-1812-4067-5766.notablePrerequisites: Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-1812-4067-5766.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding {C} for each card you've drawn this turn.
If needed, activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Faerie Formation by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.
Eventually, Kydele will produce extra mana, and you may repeat steps 2 and/or 3 as mana allows.

240-643-2988-3466.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
240-643-2988-3466.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control by any method.
When that creature enters the battlefield, Reaper King triggers, destroying that creature.
Resolve Atla Palani's trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until Purity enters the battlefield then dies, or until you choose to end the loop by destroying an opponent's permanent.
If Purity dies, it and Atla Palani trigger.
Resolve Purity's trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Continue from step 3.

703-1308-2506.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Anointed Procession that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens with haste.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Anointed Procession tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

1558-1908-3263-3907.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Underworld Hermit with haste.
When the Underworld Hermit token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Underworld Hermit token and the Squirrel tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1605-2773-3059.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

411-3286-4068.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand from the battlefield, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
Inga and Esika triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3693-5017.notablePrerequisites:
Urban Daggertooth has at least one +1/+1 counter.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters.
3693-5017.description:
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to Urban Daggertooth.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Walking Ballista.
Repeat.

2859-4619.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other black creatures.
2859-4619.description:
Cast Alter Reality by paying {1}{U}, changing all instances of "white" on Teysa to "black".
Activate Teysa by sacrificing three black creatures, targeting any creature.
The creatures die, triggering Teysa three times, creating three 1/1 black Spirit creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

132-2645-3941.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-2645-3941.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.

225-3525-3573.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
You control at least two artifacts.
225-3525-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.
